# @suluk/swagger

> Render an OpenAPI v4 'Suluk' document with Swagger UI (via the 3.1 downgrade). CANDIDATE tooling.

> Reference tooling for the OpenAPI v4.0 Suluk candidate.

### API

- `swaggerHtml`: Render a v4 document to a self-contained Swagger UI HTML page (+ downgrade diagnostics).
- `swaggerResponse`: Convenience for Bun.serve / Hono / fetch handlers: the Swagger UI page as a text/html Response.

## Optional

### Types

- `RenderResult`
